mechanics.title: External support
mechanics.reason: The shared support package is an abstract experiment configuration. A legal raid roster supplying every buff has not been validated.

mechanics.title: Cooldown execution
mechanics.reason: The report records actual activation and uptime. Supplied timing is preserved and is not an optimized racial schedule or a measurement of player execution.

mechanics.title: Revelation proc law
mechanics.reason: This enchant uses an estimated proc rate. Its interaction with critical chance needs game evidence. Exact inputs and the recorded engine preserve the assumption.
